item.title: Prowler Brings AI to Open Source Cloud Security Platform
item.description:
Prowler Brings AI to Open Source Cloud Security Platform

Prowler, the world’s most widely used open-source cloud security platform, now includes AI-driven capabilities to automate security and compliance across any cloud environment. This update positions Prowler as a platform that can “Secure ANY Cloud at AI Speed,” offering thousands of ready-to-use security checks and compliance frameworks.

🔍 Overview

Prowler is the Open Cloud Security Platform trusted by thousands to automate security and compliance in any cloud environment. With thousands of ready-to-use checks and compliance frameworks, Prowler delivers real-time, customizable monitoring and seamless integrations, making cloud security simple, scalable, and cost-effective for organizations of any size.

⚙️ Key Capabilities

Prowler now delivers AI-driven, customizable, and easy-to-use assessments, dashboards, reports, and integrations, making cloud security simple, scalable, and cost-effective for organizations of any size. Key features include:

  • Thousands of ready-to-use security checks, remediation guidance, and compliance frameworks
  • Prowler ThreatScore: Weighted risk prioritization scoring that helps you focus on the most critical security findings first

🏆 Supported Compliance Frameworks

Prowler includes hundreds of built-in controls to ensure compliance with a wide range of standards and frameworks:

Category Frameworks
Industry Standards CIS, NIST 800, NIST CSF, CISA, and MITRE ATT&CK
Regulatory Compliance and Governance RBI, FedRAMP, PCI-DSS, and NIS2
Frameworks for Sensitive Data and Privacy GDPR, HIPAA, and FFIEC
Organizational Governance and Quality Control SOC2, GXP, and ISO 27001
Cloud-Specific Frameworks AWS Foundational Technical Review (FTR), AWS Well-Architected Framework, and BSI C5
National Security Standards ENS (Spanish National Security Scheme) and KISA ISMS-P (Korean)
Custom Security Frameworks Tailored to your needs

🚀 Availability

Prowler is available in two web application formats that simplify running Prowler across your cloud provider accounts:

  • Prowler Cloud: A hosted web application
  • Prowler Local Server: A self-hosted open-source version

Both provide a user-friendly interface to visualize the results and streamline your security assessments. For more details, refer to the Prowler Local Server documentation and try Prowler Cloud.

💡 Why It Matters

By integrating AI-driven assessments and threat prioritization into an open-source platform with thousands of built-in checks and extensive compliance framework support, Prowler makes cloud security more accessible and efficient for organizations of any size. The community is invited to join the Prowler community.

#OpenSource #CloudSecurity #AI #Compliance #DevSecOps #Prowler

Source: prowler-cloud/prowler

item.title: Wiz Hires Support Engineer with AI-Driven Automation Focus
item.description:
Wiz Hires Support Engineer with AI-Driven Automation Focus

Wiz, a cloud security company, published a job advertisement for a Remote Solutions Support Engineer based in Ireland, indicating a new role that combines deep technical troubleshooting with a growing emphasis on AI-driven automation to scale support operations.

🔍 Role Overview

The Remote Solutions Support Engineer will be part of a global team delivering expert-level technical support across the Wiz cloud-native security platform. The role involves investigating complex, multi-domain issues spanning cloud infrastructure, workload protection, vulnerability management, and runtime defense across AWS, Azure, and GCP environments.

⚙️ Key Requirements

  • 5+ years of relevant customer-facing technical experience.
  • 2+ years working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) including IAM, networking, and core compute/storage services.
  • 1+ years of hands-on experience deploying, managing, and troubleshooting production Kubernetes clusters and containerized applications.
  • Experience reading and debugging code in Python, Shell, JavaScript/JSON, Java, Go, or Terraform/HCL.
  • Proficiency with command-line tools and Linux operating system environments.
  • Familiarity with the current AI landscape, including LLM architectures and the integration of AI-driven tooling into technical workflows.

💡 Why It Matters

Wiz states it is redefining security for the AI era and is “powered by Google,” offering an AI-powered platform that harnesses Google’s Threat Intelligence and Security Operations. The job description emphasizes a growing emphasis on AI-driven automation to scale support operations and improve resolution quality, with preferred qualifications including experience building or supporting agentic workflows, RAG architectures, or AI-powered automation.

🚀 Availability

Visa sponsorship is not offered for this role. The position includes an after-hours, holiday, and weekend on-call rotation.

#Wiz #CloudSecurity #AIAutomation #Kubernetes #SupportEngineer

Source: Remote Solutions Support Engineer at Wiz, Inc.

item.title: Google introduces private server-side memory to Private AI Compute platform
item.description:
Google introduces private server-side memory to Private AI Compute platform

Google is bringing private, server-side memory to its Private AI Compute platform, enabling the system to securely retain context over time and across devices.

🔍 Overview

Previously, the Private AI Compute platform and similar industry solutions were “stateless,” meaning all context was wiped once a task ended. The new technical capability introduces a persistent memory layer that functions as a secure digital vault in the cloud.

🧩 How it works

  • Storage: Information is sealed within dedicated, encrypted storage.
  • Access Control: Cryptographic keys required to unlock the data are held exclusively on personal devices, making data inaccessible to others, including Google.
  • Connectivity: An authenticated, end-to-end encrypted channel connects the device to a protected, isolated cloud environment known as a “secure enclave.”
  • Processing: The secure enclave temporarily decrypts data in isolated memory to handle requests, saves new context, and immediately encrypts it again.

⚙️ Key details

To support this development, Google has provided the following:

  • An updated technical whitepaper.
  • A tamper-proof public record of server software, allowing devices to verify the software is authentic and unaltered before sending personal data.
  • An update on technical methods, including results from an independent audit by a leading cybersecurity firm.

This research was co-developed by Google DeepMind, Platforms & Devices, Core and Cloud teams, with executive sponsorship from Four Flynn, Jay Yagnik, and David Kleidermacher.

#PrivateAICompute #CloudSecurity #GoogleDeepMind #Encryption #Privacy

Source: Advancing confidential AI with secure memory

item.title: Organizations define new specialized roles to secure AI platforms and manage cyber risks
item.description:
Organizations define new specialized roles to secure AI platforms and manage cyber risks

Organizations are establishing new technical roles to manage the intersection of artificial intelligence and cybersecurity, focusing on secure platform design and threat mitigation. These positions address emerging risks in generative AI, cloud infrastructure, and critical industrial systems.

🔍 Overview

The scope of these responsibilities spans from executive leadership to specialized engineering, covering cloud-based Data and AI/ML services, on-premises environments, and operational technology (OT).

🧩 How it works

Role Primary Functions
AI & Security Architect Design secure AI agent platforms, including tools, memory, and models; define controls for sandboxing and human approvals.
GenAI CBRNE Cyber Security Expert Red-team AI models for industrial systems and test safeguards against jailbreaks and adversarial prompts.
Senior Lead Security Engineer – Google Cloud Secure cloud-based Data and AI/ML services and guide engineering teams on security requirements.
Manager Cyber Cloud Security and AI Lead client projects on AI security strategy, governance, and regulatory requirements.
Cyber Engineering Manager Oversee AI/ML-based threat detection and lead security research for Navy cyber-physical systems.

⚙️ Key details

Professional responsibilities within these new frameworks include:

  • Defining security controls for sensitive data, credentials, and agent actions.
  • Managing emerging threats, including post-quantum risks.
  • Assessing vulnerabilities in Kubernetes, CI/CD, and serverless workloads.
  • Monitoring endpoint threats across Windows, macOS, Linux, and VDI environments.
  • Investigating incidents and strengthening detection across Microsoft 365, Azure, and AWS.
  • Designing cyber assessments for DoW programs to identify mission impacts.

💡 Why it matters

These specialized roles are designed to prevent information disclosure and misuse of AI models while ensuring that critical infrastructure and data protection standards are maintained as AI technologies are integrated into enterprise backend services.

#CyberSecurity #AISecurity #GenAI #CloudSecurity #RiskManagement
